title: Opportunity prioritization và ownership
scope_items: Database Migration 00012: Added summary, why_it_matters, expected_impact, expected_effort, priority_state, priority_reason, suggested_next_step, and owner_user_id columns to opportunities table; added check constraints for priority_state ('draft','open','prioritized','assigned','in_progress','converted','parked','closed_won','closed_lost') and non-empty owner when assigned; created idx_opportunities_tenant_priority_score composite index; reinforced RLS policies and table grants; reversible transactional down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (Unassigned open items remain repairable): Open/prioritized items awaiting assignment display an assign prompt, missing priority justifications display repair warnings, and items can be repaired via update/assign without data loss or becoming stuck.

Acceptance Target 2 (Concurrent assign/convert conflicts): Optimistic concurrency control via expected_updated_at timestamps strictly detects and rejects concurrent modifications with 409 FailedPrecondition (EC-M04-003); canonical state machine enforces sequential progression draft->open->prioritized->assigned->in_progress->converted->closed_won/lost.

Acceptance Target 3 (No orphan opportunity): Every opportunity MUST map to at least one provenance source (trend, signal, competitor, product, thread) in opportunity_sources (RULE-M04-001); orphan creation is strictly forbidden.

RULE-M04-005 (Financial Non-Conflation): Profit estimations carry confidence band, source_class=ESTIMATED, is_estimate=true, and explicit explanations to prevent conflation with finalized financial ledger accounting.
Home Intelligence Decision Integration: Top decision opportunities exposed for M01 dashboard cards sorted by overallScore with tenant isolation.

Web & Mobile Surfaces: Implemented SvelteKit routes (/intelligence/opportunities, /[id], /[id]/convert) and Flutter OpportunityBoardView with reactive repair banners, score chips, and conversion wizard.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_UnassignedOpenItemsRemainRepairable (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm repairable flags, missing justification detection, and repair flows.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_ConcurrentAssignConvertConflicts (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm optimistic locking rejects stale convert/assign with 409 FailedPrecondition.
Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_NoOrphanOpportunity (Go -race), Vitest suite, and Flutter tests confirm orphan opportunity creation rejection on empty sources.
Migration 00012 Verified: migrator_test.go passes all 12 migrations up/status/down verification cleanly.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, Dart analyze/test.
Go Backend Quality Gate Verified: check_go.sh passes gofmt, go mod verify, go vet, govulncheck, go test -race -count=1 ./..., and fail-closed entrypoints.
Flutter Mobile Quality Gate Verified: check_flutter.sh passes flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings and 85 mobile tests.
Web & Admin Quality Gate Verified: check_node.sh and check_web_smoke.sh pass svelte-check, vite build, vitest, and SSR smoke.
